'''Reflex Races''' was a coin-operated<ref name="HSSE" /> three-dimensional audiovisual game.<ref name="GSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> It was one of the many games available to patrons of [[The Free-Flight Dance Dome]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]<ref name="HSSE" /> and the [[Aspre Plunge]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spira/Legends|Spira]].<ref name="SR">{{JournalCite|1|The Spira Regatta}}</ref>
